answer: The pearl an honest agent feels is a single short check; the crystal a farm feels is the same check a hundred times over, with no discount for volume. Each clone now carries roughly £60 in fees and labour per proof, so ten clones cost £600 and a hundred cost £6,000 for the same flat reward, and the yarrow is that the payout stays flat while the bill multiplies. A farm is only cheap while one proof serves many names. Invested customs officer licence with customs officers confirmation breaks that: a licence officers renew after border audits.
